author: NPR Music
description:
Tom Huizenga | November 23, 2026
Performances at the Tiny Desk often reach dramatic heights, but rarely are we treated to that grandest of all music drama, opera, in our office space.

Will Liverman is an opera singer whose star continues to rise. The versatile, burgundy-voiced baritone sang two breakthrough leading roles recently in X: The Life and Times of Malcolm X and Fire Shut Up in My Bones, both at New York's Metropolitan Opera. Liverman has also written an opera himself, a spin-off of Rossini's The Barber of Seville, sporting touches of soul and funk, set in a Black barber shop in Chicago's South Side.

"I understand that some people don't really vibe with opera," he admits to an audience of NPR staffers. Liverman doesn't believe music needs to be boxed into tidy categories. "Music is all about storytelling, and a way to connect to emotions and the human experience."

title: Will Liverman: Tiny Desk Concert
